query: Our receipt assistant works on one image. Help turn it into a reliable system that interprets messy receipts, validates reimbursements and emits supported explanations; build and test the whole path.
build me a support agent that can find orders and make authorized changes. I want the architecture, working implementation and evidence it behaves safely.
